entities.summary: Eduardo Alejo Pavlovsky, often nicknamed Tato Pavlovsky, was an Argentine playwright, psychoanalyst, actor, and novelist. His best-known plays included El señor Galindez in 1973, La muerte de Margueritte Duras, and Potestad.
